items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: She said, "You haven't heard John play it."

ctx.x: Figurations, as the ragtime players would say.

Yes, he certainly was. A lot of ornaments and decorations and everything. And he was really making it sound good, because I know -- I spoke to a young lady and I said, "I don't like such and such a number," and she'd say, "Say, you haven't heard --," I've forgotten the fellow's name now. She said, anyway, I'll just say John. She said, "You haven't heard John play it." So, I finally got a chance to hear the wrote (or co-wrote) 'Dixie' by James Bland
John play it and it didn't sound like it did when --
